{
  "$schema": "./packages/core/bridge.config.schema.json",
  "version": 1,
  "name": "Bridge DS",
  "repo": {
    "owner": "the-bridge-company",
    "name": "ai-design-system-demo",
    "defaultBranch": "main"
  },
  "tokens": {
    "root": "packages/tokens/src",
    "include": ["**/*.tokens.json"],
    "tiers": {
      "primitive": ["primitives"],
      "brand": ["brands"],
      "base": ["semantic/base.tokens.json"],
      "semantic": ["semantic"],
      "density": ["density"],
      "component": ["components"]
    },
    "layers": [
      { "files": "primitives/*.tokens.json" },
      { "files": "semantic/base.tokens.json" },
      { "files": "brands/{brand}.tokens.json" },
      { "files": "semantic/{theme}.tokens.json" },
      { "files": "brands/{brand}.{theme}.tokens.json", "optional": true },
      { "files": "density/{density}.tokens.json" },
      { "files": "components/*.tokens.json" }
    ]
  },
  "modes": {
    "brand": { "values": ["bridge", "ocean"], "default": "bridge" },
    "theme": { "values": ["light", "dark"], "default": "light", "parity": true },
    "density": { "values": ["comfortable", "compact"], "default": "comfortable" }
  },
  "contrast": { "path": "packages/tokens/src/contrast.checks.json", "modes": ["brand", "theme"] },
  "components": {
    "dir": "packages/react/src/components",
    "docsSuffix": ".docs.json",
    "styleSuffix": ".module.css",
    "reference": "Button",
    "index": "packages/react/src/index.ts"
  },
  "docs": {
    "designLanguage": "docs/DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md",
    "guidelines": "AGENTS.md",
    "governance": "docs/GOVERNANCE.md"
  },
  "changesets": { "dir": ".changeset", "package": "@bridge-ds/tokens" },
  "cssVar": { "prefix": "--", "separator": "-" },
  "governance": {
    "protectedBranches": ["main", "master"],
    "branchPrefix": "bridge/",
    "labels": ["source: mcp"],
    "guardrails": [
      "AGENTS.md",
      "CLAUDE.md",
      ".github/",
      ".stylelintrc.json",
      "docs/GOVERNANCE.md",
      "bridge.config.json",
      "packages/tokens/src/contrast.checks.json"
    ],
    "owners": { "design": ["peterbono"], "tech": ["peterbono"] },
    "rights": { "approveDesign": ["design"], "approveTech": ["tech"], "ship": ["tech"] },
    "soloOwnerCanApproveBoth": true,
    "override": { "allowed": ["peterbono"], "requireReason": true, "minReasonLength": 20 }
  },
  "changes": "direct",
  "previews": {
    "packages": ["@bridge-ds/tokens", "@bridge-ds/core", "@bridge-ds/react", "@bridge-ds/toolbar"],
    "apps": {
      "docs": "https://bridge-docs-git-{branch}-peterbonos-projects.vercel.app",
      "storybook": "https://bridge-storybook-git-{branch}-peterbonos-projects.vercel.app",
      "admin": "https://bridge-admin-git-{branch}-peterbonos-projects.vercel.app"
    },
    "production": {
      "docs": "https://bridgedesignsystem.com",
      "storybook": "https://bridge-storybook.floriangouloubi.com",
      "admin": "https://bridge-demo.floriangouloubi.com"
    }
  },
  "products": [
    { "key": "admin-app", "name": "Art print shop", "repo": "the-bridge-company/art-print-shop", "design": { "repo": "the-bridge-company/art-print-shop-design", "preview": "https://{branch}.art-print-shop-design.pages.dev" }, "preview": "https://{branch}.art-print-shop.pages.dev", "production": "https://art-print-shop.pages.dev", "framework": "react", "screens": { "/#/": "resources/dashboard/**", "/#/orders": "resources/orders/**", "/#/invoices": "resources/invoices/**", "/#/customers": "resources/customers/**", "/#/products": "resources/products/**", "/#/categories": "resources/categories/**", "/#/reviews": "resources/reviews/**", "/#/segments": "resources/segments/**" } },
    { "key": "dasboard-data-test-d", "name": "Dasboard Data test D", "repo": "the-bridge-company/dasboard-data-test-d", "design": { "repo": "the-bridge-company/dasboard-data-test-d-design" }, "framework": "react" },
    { "key": "library", "name": "Library", "path": "packages", "framework": "react", "default": true }
  ],
  "tooling": {
    "paths": [
      "apps/docs-site/",
      "apps/figma-plugin/",
      "packages/core/",
      "packages/cli/",
      "packages/mcp/",
      "packages/toolbar/",
      "packages/visual/",
      "packages/stylelint-plugin/",
      "packages/eslint-plugin/",
      "scripts/",
      "deploy/",
      "templates/",
      "docs/",
      "!docs/DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md",
      ".github/",
      "CLAUDE.md",
      ".mcp.json",
      "vitest.config.ts"
    ],
    "scopes": ["studio", "explorations", "toolbar", "cli", "core", "mcp", "config", "previews", "docs-site", "measure", "pieces", "figma-plugin"]
  },
  "figma": { "file": "https://www.figma.com/design/IEhO7sznq4yr6X5iLqZqzz/Untitled" }
}
